I'm tracing through the code: there's a leftover dead condition that never actually triggers since "best" starts as None, so it just gets skipped harmlessly. Then I identify the starting cell as the one with value 1, and trace the greedy path logic — from 1 it jumps to the smallest neighbor, but from that neighbor the smallest neighbor loops right back to 1, creating an alternating pattern.

I also notice an indentation issue: the function body isn't properly indented under the signature, which would cause an actual failure if inserted as-is — that's a real defect worth flagging, maybe knocking correctness down a bit, while the other two criteria still look solid.
